records.translation: Alignering: minsta antal kärnor per ruta
Flatfält: minsta antal celler per ring
Profil: minsta rho för essentiell axel
Rapport: största avstånd för externa celler i px

records.source: Which Cellpose model segments the nuclei of each stitched sequencing well. 'cpsam' runs the default model of the installed Cellpose; any other name or path, such as one chosen with Model zoo, is loaded as that model. Changing it changes which objects are found, and so which nuclei the reads are attributed to. Settings files that name cellpose_model still load into it. Default 'cpsam'.
records.translation: Vilken Cellpose-modell som segmenterar cellkärnorna i varje ihopsydd sekvenseringsbrunn. 'cpsam' kör standardmodellen i den installerade Cellpose; alla andra namn eller sökvägar, till exempel en modell som valts med Model zoo, läses in som den modellen. Att ändra den ändrar vilka objekt som hittas, och därmed vilka cellkärnor läsningarna tillskrivs. Inställningsfiler som anger cellpose_model läses fortfarande in i den. Standard 'cpsam'.

records.key: Where a Cell Painting Gallery plate is read when OPS layout is cpg_cropped: the cropped-image folder, its wells and sites, the painting channels and sequencing cycles stacked from it, and what to do with a missing or mismatched plane.
records.source: Where a Cell Painting Gallery plate is read when OPS layout is cpg_cropped: the cropped-image folder, its wells and sites, the painting channels and sequencing cycles stacked from it, and what to do with a missing or mismatched plane.
records.translation: Var en platta från Cell Painting Gallery läses när OPS-layouten är cpg_cropped: mappen med beskurna bilder, dess brunnar och positioner, de målningskanaler och sekvenseringscykler som staplas från den, och vad som görs med ett saknat eller felmatchat plan.

records.key: How much of the machine the run may use and how it waits for it: the graphics card, parallel workers, BLAS threads, local staging of phenotype fields and the wait for a free card. These change what a run costs; with deterministic BLAS on they leave its tables as they are.
records.source: How much of the machine the run may use and how it waits for it: the graphics card, parallel workers, BLAS threads, local staging of phenotype fields and the wait for a free card. These change what a run costs; with deterministic BLAS on they leave its tables as they are.
records.translation: Hur stor del av datorn körningen får använda och hur den väntar på resurser: grafikkortet, parallella arbetsprocesser, BLAS-trådar, lokal mellanlagring av fenotypfält och väntan på ett ledigt kort. Dessa ändrar vad en körning kostar; med deterministisk BLAS påslagen lämnar de dess tabeller oförändrade.

records.key: Copies each finished well to archive storage, checks the copy and can free the local disk. A rerun resumes from the wells already archived.
records.source: Copies each finished well to archive storage, checks the copy and can free the local disk. A rerun resumes from the wells already archived.
records.translation: Kopierar varje färdig brunn till arkivlagring, kontrollerar kopian och kan frigöra den lokala disken. En omkörning fortsätter från de brunnar som redan har arkiverats.

records.key: How the sequencing tiles of a well are placed and blended into one nuclear image: the tile overlap, the blend, the reading and registration workers, and which sites are run.
records.source: How the sequencing tiles of a well are placed and blended into one nuclear image: the tile overlap, the blend, the reading and registration workers, and which sites are run.
records.translation: Hur sekvenseringsrutorna i en brunn placeras och tonas samman till en kärnbild: rutornas överlappning, övertoningen, läs- och registreringsprocesserna, och vilka positioner som körs.

records.key: Reuse the tile placement of an earlier full run instead of registering every tile again, with checks that the seed still fits; and export a seed from this run.
records.source: Reuse the tile placement of an earlier full run instead of registering every tile again, with checks that the seed still fits; and export a seed from this run.
records.translation: Återanvänd rutplaceringen från en tidigare fullständig körning i stället för att registrera varje ruta igen, med kontroller av att fröet fortfarande passar; och exportera ett frö från den här körningen.

records.key: Which Cellpose model and diameter segment the nuclei of the stitched sequencing well, how the segmentation windows overlap, and whether finished windows are kept so an interrupted well resumes. The reads are assigned to these nuclei.
records.source: Which Cellpose model and diameter segment the nuclei of the stitched sequencing well, how the segmentation windows overlap, and whether finished windows are kept so an interrupted well resumes. The reads are assigned to these nuclei.
records.translation: Vilken Cellpose-modell och diameter som segmenterar cellkärnorna i den ihopsydda sekvenseringsbrunnen, hur segmenteringsfönstren överlappar, och om färdiga fönster sparas så att en avbruten brunn kan återupptas. Avläsningarna tilldelas dessa cellkärnor.

records.key: Which channel carries which base, how bright a spot must be to be a read, which spot detector runs, and how each cycle's channels are registered before the bases are read.
records.source: Which channel carries which base, how bright a spot must be to be a read, which spot detector runs, and how each cycle's channels are registered before the bases are read.
records.translation: Vilken kanal som bär vilken bas, hur ljus en fläck måste vara för att räknas som en avläsning, vilken fläckdetektor som körs, och hur varje cykels kanaler registreras innan baserna läses.

records.key: How each spot's four channel values become a base: the read mode, the dye crosstalk correction, the calibration of each cycle from the library, a named preset, and whether every read is stored.
records.source: How each spot's four channel values become a base: the read mode, the dye crosstalk correction, the calibration of each cycle from the library, a named preset, and whether every read is stored.
records.translation: Hur varje fläcks fyra kanalvärden blir en bas: läsläget, korrigeringen för färgämnesöverhörning, kalibreringen av varje cykel utifrån biblioteket, en namngiven förinställning, och om varje avläsning sparas.

records.key: How reads become a nucleus's guide: how far a read may lie from a nucleus, the cell rule, mismatches, read counts and fractions, the near-miss runner-up, tie handling and quality-weighted votes.
records.source: How reads become a nucleus's guide: how far a read may lie from a nucleus, the cell rule, mismatches, read counts and fractions, the near-miss runner-up, tie handling and quality-weighted votes.
records.translation: Hur avläsningar blir en cellkärnas guide: hur långt från en cellkärna en avläsning får ligga, cellregeln, felmatchningar, antal och andelar avläsningar, tvåan vid nära miss, hantering av oavgjorda fall och kvalitetsviktade röster.

records.key: For a nucleus no read reached, call the brightest nearby pixels like reads, with its own percentile, radius, pixel count, share and quality limits. Off leaves such nuclei uncalled.
records.source: For a nucleus no read reached, call the brightest nearby pixels like reads, with its own percentile, radius, pixel count, share and quality limits. Off leaves such nuclei uncalled.
records.translation: För en cellkärna som ingen avläsning nådde anropas de ljusaste närliggande pixlarna som avläsningar, med egna gränser för percentil, radie, antal pixlar, andel och kvalitet. Avstängt lämnar sådana cellkärnor utan anrop.

records.key: Decoy barcodes estimate the false-call rate, and auto thresholds pick the decode settings that keep it under a target: the decoy count, FDR scale, target, grid, tuning split, objective and fallback.
records.source: Decoy barcodes estimate the false-call rate, and auto thresholds pick the decode settings that keep it under a target: the decoy count, FDR scale, target, grid, tuning split, objective and fallback.
records.translation: Lockstreckkoder uppskattar andelen felaktiga anrop, och automatiska trösklar väljer de avkodningsinställningar som håller den under ett mål: antalet lockbeten, FDR-skalan, målet, rutnätet, uppdelningen för justering, målfunktionen och reserven.

records.key: After the decode, a model of what makes a call a decoy, and a calibrated probability that each genotype call is right, with an optional floor that drops the weakest calls.
records.source: After the decode, a model of what makes a call a decoy, and a calibrated probability that each genotype call is right, with an optional floor that drops the weakest calls.
records.translation: Efter avkodningen: en modell av vad som gör ett anrop till ett lockbete, och en kalibrerad sannolikhet för att varje genotypanrop är rätt, med ett valfritt golv som tar bort de svagaste anropen.

records.key: For libraries read by the first cycles of the spacer itself: the library columns, prefix length and cycles, masked cycles, prefix collisions, the read correction metric and distance, and each cell's quality class.
records.source: For libraries read by the first cycles of the spacer itself: the library columns, prefix length and cycles, masked cycles, prefix collisions, the read correction metric and distance, and each cell's quality class.
records.translation: För bibliotek som läses via spacerns egna första cykler: bibliotekets kolumner, prefixlängd och cykler, maskerade cykler, prefixkollisioner, måttet och avståndet för läskorrigering, och varje cells kvalitetsklass.

records.key: The controls and thresholds of the spacer-prefix decode: a shuffled-whitelist control, decoy prefixes and their FDR scale, the weakest read called, and per-well threshold tuning to an FDR target.
records.source: The controls and thresholds of the spacer-prefix decode: a shuffled-whitelist control, decoy prefixes and their FDR scale, the weakest read called, and per-well threshold tuning to an FDR target.
records.translation: Kontrollerna och trösklarna för spacer-prefixavkodningen: en kontroll med omblandad vitlista, lockprefix och deras FDR-skala, den svagaste avläsning som anropas, och tröskeljustering per brunn mot ett FDR-mål.

records.key: The prefix_fdr_sweep phase: the FDR targets, distances, read counts, rules and quality cuts it tries, with site-bootstrap intervals and shuffled-whitelist controls, on the read tables named.
records.source: The prefix_fdr_sweep phase: the FDR targets, distances, read counts, rules and quality cuts it tries, with site-bootstrap intervals and shuffled-whitelist controls, on the read tables named.
records.translation: Fasen prefix_fdr_sweep: de FDR-mål, avstånd, antal avläsningar, regler och kvalitetsgränser den provar, med bootstrapintervall över positioner och kontroller med omblandad vitlista, på de namngivna lästabellerna.

records.key: Match spaCR's cells and calls with another pipeline's on the same fields, by centroid distance or mask overlap, and report agreement with a shuffled-call control.
records.source: Match spaCR's cells and calls with another pipeline's on the same fields, by centroid distance or mask overlap, and report agreement with a shuffled-call control.
records.translation: Matcha spaCR:s celler och anrop mot en annan pipelines på samma fält, efter avstånd mellan centroider eller maskernas överlapp, och rapportera överensstämmelsen med en kontroll med omblandade anrop.

records.key: Which phenotype channels are measured and which channel and Cellpose models segment the cells and nuclei, at what diameter, downsampling and batch size, on which sites.
records.source: Which phenotype channels are measured and which channel and Cellpose models segment the cells and nuclei, at what diameter, downsampling and batch size, on which sites.
records.translation: Vilka fenotypkanaler som mäts och vilken kanal och vilka Cellpose-modeller som segmenterar cellerna och cellkärnorna, med vilken diameter, nedsampling och batchstorlek, på vilka positioner.

records.key: For a plate whose phenotype channels were imaged in more than one acquisition: which acquisition holds which channels, and how a second acquisition is registered onto the first.
records.source: For a plate whose phenotype channels were imaged in more than one acquisition: which acquisition holds which channels, and how a second acquisition is registered onto the first.
records.translation: För en platta vars fenotypkanaler avbildades i mer än ett förvärv: vilket förvärv som innehåller vilka kanaler, och hur ett andra förvärv registreras mot det första.

records.key: Which feature families are measured beyond the standard intensity and shape set: texture, Zernike moments, Funk et al. 2022's features and spaCR's profiling families.
records.source: Which feature families are measured beyond the standard intensity and shape set: texture, Zernike moments, Funk et al. 2022's features and spaCR's profiling families.
records.translation: Vilka egenskapsfamiljer som mäts utöver standarduppsättningen för intensitet och form: textur, Zernike-moment, egenskaperna från Funk et al. 2022 och spaCR:s profileringsfamiljer.

records.key: How uneven illumination of the phenotype fields is corrected: the method, the plate's maps and the fields they are built from, and the nuclear-median map of the DNA channel.
records.source: How uneven illumination of the phenotype fields is corrected: the method, the plate's maps and the fields they are built from, and the nuclear-median map of the DNA channel.
records.translation: Hur ojämn belysning av fenotypfälten korrigeras: metoden, plattans kartor och de fält de byggs från, och kärnmediankartan för DNA-kanalen.

records.key: How the nuclear-median flat-field map is fitted: block size, fit method and width, ridge, floor, the central normalisation square and how the map is read at field pixels.
records.source: How the nuclear-median flat-field map is fitted: block size, fit method and width, ridge, floor, the central normalisation square and how the map is read at field pixels.
records.translation: Hur flatfältskartan baserad på kärnmedianer anpassas: blockstorlek, anpassningsmetod och bredd, ridge, golv, den centrala normaliseringskvadraten och hur kartan läses av vid fältets pixlar.

records.key: Checks a flat-field map on fields left out of it: which and how many fields, their images and masks, other maps compared, and the radial table with bootstrap intervals.
records.source: Checks a flat-field map on fields left out of it: which and how many fields, their images and masks, other maps compared, and the radial table with bootstrap intervals.
records.translation: Kontrollerar en flatfältskarta på fält som hållits utanför den: vilka och hur många fält, deras bilder och masker, andra kartor som jämförs, och den radiella tabellen med bootstrapintervall.

records.key: What the ph_merged and ph_tables phases write: the merged channel stacks, their correction and data type, and the layout of the cell, nucleus and cytoplasm tables.
records.source: What the ph_merged and ph_tables phases write: the merged channel stacks, their correction and data type, and the layout of the cell, nucleus and cytoplasm tables.
records.translation: Vad faserna ph_merged och ph_tables skriver: de sammanslagna kanalstaplarna, deras korrigering och datatyp, och layouten för tabellerna för celler, cellkärnor och cytoplasma.

records.key: What the ph_crops phase cuts: how many cells per guide, the crop size, channels and correction, the controls kept, the masks stored and how the crop store is sharded.
records.source: What the ph_crops phase cuts: how many cells per guide, the crop size, channels and correction, the controls kept, the masks stored and how the crop store is sharded.
records.translation: Vad fasen ph_crops skär ut: hur många celler per guide, utsnittens storlek, kanaler och korrigering, de kontroller som behålls, de masker som sparas och hur utsnittslagret delas upp i fragment.

records.key: How each phenotype field is placed on the sequencing well: the route, the stitch source, the pattern-match votes and fallback, and the per-tile alignment model and its matching radius.
records.source: How each phenotype field is placed on the sequencing well: the route, the stitch source, the pattern-match votes and fallback, and the per-tile alignment model and its matching radius.
records.translation: Hur varje fenotypfält placeras på sekvenseringsbrunnen: vägen, källan för sammanfogningen, mönstermatchningens röster och reserv, samt aligneringsmodellen per ruta och dess parningsradie.

records.key: Which copy of a cell seen in two overlapping fields is kept, how copies are found and scored, and whether cells of unregistered fields are dropped.
records.source: Which copy of a cell seen in two overlapping fields is kept, how copies are found and scored, and whether cells of unregistered fields are dropped.
records.translation: Vilken kopia av en cell som syns i två överlappande fält som behålls, hur kopior hittas och poängsätts, och om celler i oregistrerade fält tas bort.

records.key: The report phase: the yield funnel from nuclei to genotyped phenotypes, the overlap-zone match rates, and counts compared with a published table under a shuffled-label control.
records.source: The report phase: the yield funnel from nuclei to genotyped phenotypes, the overlap-zone match rates, and counts compared with a published table under a shuffled-label control.
records.translation: Rapportfasen: utbytestratten från cellkärnor till genotypade fenotyper, matchningsgraden i överlappszonerna, och antal jämförda med en publicerad tabell under en kontroll med omblandade etiketter.

records.key: Which wells and cells are pooled, which features and rows are dropped, how profiles are normalised, and how the TVN alignment to the controls is fitted.
records.source: Which wells and cells are pooled, which features and rows are dropped, how profiles are normalised, and how the TVN alignment to the controls is fitted.
records.translation: Vilka brunnar och celler som slås samman, vilka egenskaper och rader som tas bort, hur profiler normaliseras, och hur TVN-anpassningen till kontrollerna skattas.

records.key: How each gene is tested against the non-targeting guides and how hits are called: bootstrap replicates, the null, the features tested, and the expression-based hit lists.
records.source: How each gene is tested against the non-targeting guides and how hits are called: bootstrap replicates, the null, the features tested, and the expression-based hit lists.
records.translation: Hur varje gen testas mot de icke-riktade guiderna och hur träffar anropas: bootstrapreplikat, nollfördelningen, de testade egenskaperna och de uttrycksbaserade träfflistorna.

records.key: How mitotic cells are called, whether profiles are split by cell-cycle phase, the per-phase gene tests, and the mitotic-index test against a published table.
records.source: How mitotic cells are called, whether profiles are split by cell-cycle phase, the per-phase gene tests, and the mitotic-index test against a published table.
records.translation: Hur mitotiska celler anropas, om profiler delas upp efter cellcykelfas, gentesterna per fas, och mitosindextestet mot en publicerad tabell.

records.key: Per-gene penetrance, genes whose cells split into responders and escapers, and the effect of a knockout on its unperturbed neighbours, with their nulls.
records.source: Per-gene penetrance, genes whose cells split into responders and escapers, and the effect of a knockout on its unperturbed neighbours, with their nulls.
records.translation: Penetrans per gen, gener vars celler delas upp i responders och rymlingar, och effekten av en knockout på dess icke-störda grannar, med deras nollfördelningar.

records.key: How gene profiles are weighted, corrected for guide efficacy, shrunk toward the controls and cleared of generic axes, and how gene similarity is written.
records.source: How gene profiles are weighted, corrected for guide efficacy, shrunk toward the controls and cleared of generic axes, and how gene similarity is written.
records.translation: Hur genprofiler viktas, korrigeras för guideeffektivitet, krymps mot kontrollerna och rensas från generiska axlar, och hur genlikhet skrivs.

records.key: The stored-profile path: which per-well cell tables are profiled, the run name and recipe, the minimum cells, the cell state and gene universe, and extra embedding or fusion blocks.
records.source: The stored-profile path: which per-well cell tables are profiled, the run name and recipe, the minimum cells, the cell state and gene universe, and extra embedding or fusion blocks.
records.translation: Vägen för sparade profiler: vilka celltabeller per brunn som profileras, körningens namn och recept, minsta antal celler, celltillståndet och genuniversumet, samt extra inbäddnings- eller fusionsblock.

records.key: The per-gene energy-distance test of the etest phase: the cells it reads, the distance, the reference and null pseudo-genes, and the test mode. Its power curve is set in the Power module.
records.source: The per-gene energy-distance test of the etest phase: the cells it reads, the distance, the reference and null pseudo-genes, and the test mode. Its power curve is set in the Power module.
records.translation: Energiavståndstestet per gen i fasen etest: cellerna det läser, avståndet, referens- och noll-pseudogenerna, och testläget. Dess styrkekurva ställs in i modulen Power.

records.key: Cluster the gene profiles as Funk et al. 2022 did and score the clusters against CORUM, KEGG and STRING, or a published clustering, at a chosen cluster count.
records.source: Cluster the gene profiles as Funk et al. 2022 did and score the clusters against CORUM, KEGG and STRING, or a published clustering, at a chosen cluster count.
records.translation: Klustra genprofilerna som Funk et al. 2022 gjorde och poängsätt klustren mot CORUM, KEGG och STRING, eller mot en publicerad klustring, vid ett valt antal kluster.

records.key: The cluster_sweep phase: the graphs, neighbours, Leiden resolutions and seeds tried, the shuffled-label controls, and published clusterings compared on the same genes.
records.source: The cluster_sweep phase: the graphs, neighbours, Leiden resolutions and seeds tried, the shuffled-label controls, and published clusterings compared on the same genes.
records.translation: Fasen cluster_sweep: graferna, grannarna, Leiden-upplösningarna och fröna som provas, kontrollerna med omblandade etiketter, och publicerade klustringar som jämförs på samma gener.

records.key: Guide-bootstrap consensus clustering: the bootstraps and seeds, the graph and cluster count, how the co-clustering matrix is cut, and which genes are left unassigned.
records.source: Guide-bootstrap consensus clustering: the bootstraps and seeds, the graph and cluster count, how the co-clustering matrix is cut, and which genes are left unassigned.
records.translation: Konsensusklustring med guide-bootstrap: bootstrapurvalen och fröna, grafen och antalet kluster, hur samklustringsmatrisen skärs, och vilka gener som lämnas otilldelade.

records.key: What the consensus clusters: the guide rows, the profile space, the profile or gene-pairs mode, and its search, workers and cell tables.
records.source: What the consensus clusters: the guide rows, the profile space, the profile or gene-pairs mode, and its search, workers and cell tables.
records.translation: Vad konsensusen klustrar: guideraderna, profilrummet, läget för profiler eller genpar, samt dess sökning, arbetsprocesser och celltabeller.

records.key: The cluster_bench_test phase: paired replicates, the jitter gate that calibrates it, the test level and margin, the reference half and the size-matched null.
records.source: The cluster_bench_test phase: paired replicates, the jitter gate that calibrates it, the test level and margin, the reference half and the size-matched null.
records.translation: Fasen cluster_bench_test: parade replikat, brusspärren som kalibrerar den, testnivån och marginalen, referenshalvan och den storleksmatchade nollfördelningen.

records.key: The modules phase, which clusters gene profiles into a module atlas, and the mitocarta phase, which scores clusterings against MitoCarta and published module tables.
records.source: The modules phase, which clusters gene profiles into a module atlas, and the mitocarta phase, which scores clusterings against MitoCarta and published module tables.
records.translation: Fasen modules, som klustrar genprofiler till en modulatlas, och fasen mitocarta, som poängsätter klustringar mot MitoCarta och publicerade modultabeller.

records.key: The score phase: which analyses and genes are scored, the copairs and EFAAR metrics, the null size, complex size, cluster jitter, workers and figures.
records.source: The score phase: which analyses and genes are scored, the copairs and EFAAR metrics, the null size, complex size, cluster jitter, workers and figures.
records.translation: Fasen score: vilka analyser och gener som poängsätts, måtten copairs och EFAAR, nollfördelningens storlek, komplexstorlek, klusterbrus, arbetsprocesser och figurer.

records.key: The reference files and choices the score phase reads: the CORUM and STRING files, STRING thresholds, complex coverage, PCA variance and the benchmark genes and seed.
records.source: The reference files and choices the score phase reads: the CORUM and STRING files, STRING thresholds, complex coverage, PCA variance and the benchmark genes and seed.
records.translation: Referensfilerna och valen som fasen score läser: CORUM- och STRING-filerna, STRING-trösklar, komplextäckning, PCA-varians samt jämförelsegenerna och fröet.

records.key: The evaluate phase: the references gene profiles are scored against, the half used, the null size, held-out complexes, fitness-matched decoys, the time split and covariates.
records.source: The evaluate phase: the references gene profiles are scored against, the half used, the null size, held-out complexes, fitness-matched decoys, the time split and covariates.
records.translation: Fasen evaluate: referenserna som genprofilerna poängsätts mot, halvan som används, nollfördelningens storlek, undanhållna komplex, fitnessmatchade lockbeten, tidsuppdelningen och kovariaterna.

records.key: How each phenotype field is joined to the sequencing well: the route and model that align its nuclei to the sequencing nuclei, which copy of a cell imaged twice is kept, and the yield report that counts cells from nuclei to genotyped phenotypes.
records.source: How each phenotype field is joined to the sequencing well: the route and model that align its nuclei to the sequencing nuclei, which copy of a cell imaged twice is kept, and the yield report that counts cells from nuclei to genotyped phenotypes.
records.translation: Hur varje fenotypfält kopplas till sekvenseringsbrunnen: vägen och modellen som alignerar dess cellkärnor mot sekvenseringskärnorna, vilken kopia av en cell som avbildats två gånger som behålls, och utbytesrapporten som räknar celler från cellkärnor till genotypade fenotyper.

records.key: How genotyped cells become guide and gene profiles and gene calls: pooling and normalisation, per-gene tests and hit lists, cell-cycle resolved profiles, penetrance and neighbour effects, profile weighting, the stored-profile run and the e-test.
records.source: How genotyped cells become guide and gene profiles and gene calls: pooling and normalisation, per-gene tests and hit lists, cell-cycle resolved profiles, penetrance and neighbour effects, profile weighting, the stored-profile run and the e-test.
records.translation: Hur genotypade celler blir guide- och genprofiler och genanrop: sammanslagning och normalisering, tester och träfflistor per gen, cellcykelupplösta profiler, penetrans och grannefekter, profilviktning, körningen med sparade profiler och e-testet.

records.key: How gene profiles are clustered and the clusters tested: the benchmark against complexes and pathways, the Leiden resolution sweep, guide-bootstrap consensus clustering, the calibrated cluster test and the module atlas.
records.source: How gene profiles are clustered and the clusters tested: the benchmark against complexes and pathways, the Leiden resolution sweep, guide-bootstrap consensus clustering, the calibrated cluster test and the module atlas.
records.translation: Hur genprofiler klustras och klustren testas: jämförelsen mot komplex och signalvägar, Leiden-upplösningssvepet, konsensusklustring med guide-bootstrap, det kalibrerade klustertestet och modulatlasen.

records.key: How profiles and clusterings are scored against reference gene sets: the copairs and EFAAR scores of the score phase, the CORUM and STRING files they read, and the held-out evaluation of the evaluate phase.
records.source: How profiles and clusterings are scored against reference gene sets: the copairs and EFAAR scores of the score phase, the CORUM and STRING files they read, and the held-out evaluation of the evaluate phase.
records.translation: Hur profiler och klustringar poängsätts mot referensgenuppsättningar: copairs- och EFAAR-poängen i fasen score, CORUM- och STRING-filerna de läser, och den undanhållna utvärderingen i fasen evaluate.

records.key: How the phenotype acquisition is segmented, corrected and measured: the channels and Cellpose models for cells and nuclei, a second acquisition's channels, the feature families, the flat-field maps and their check, and the merged images, tables and crops written from the measured cells.
records.source: How the phenotype acquisition is segmented, corrected and measured: the channels and Cellpose models for cells and nuclei, a second acquisition's channels, the feature families, the flat-field maps and their check, and the merged images, tables and crops written from the measured cells.
records.translation: Hur fenotypförvärvet segmenteras, korrigeras och mäts: kanalerna och Cellpose-modellerna för celler och cellkärnor, ett andra förvärvs kanaler, egenskapsfamiljerna, flatfältskartorna och kontrollen av dem, samt de sammanslagna bilder, tabeller och utsnitt som skrivs från de uppmätta cellerna.

records.key: Which plate this is and which guides and genes are controls: the plate name, the guide design table with its gene symbols, the gene-name prefix of the non-targeting controls, and an optional genotype table that replaces the decode's calls.
records.source: Which plate this is and which guides and genes are controls: the plate name, the guide design table with its gene symbols, the gene-name prefix of the non-targeting controls, and an optional genotype table that replaces the decode's calls.
records.translation: Vilken platta detta är och vilka guider och gener som är kontroller: plattans namn, guidedesigntabellen med dess gensymboler, gennamnsprefixet för de icke-riktade kontrollerna, och en valfri genotyptabell som ersätter avkodningens anrop.

records.key: The OPS power curve is in {folder}.

records.key: An OPS settings file, such as the one the OPS module saved for the profile run. Empty uses the OPS defaults. Default empty.

records.translation: En OPS-inställningsfil, till exempel den som OPS-modulen sparade för profilkörningen. Tom använder OPS-standardvärdena. Standard tom.

records.key: How many cells per gene an optical pooled screen needs: the e-test of a finished profile run, repeated on cells drawn down to each cap, with an optional retrieval curve against reference gene sets. It is set and run in the Power module.
records.source: How many cells per gene an optical pooled screen needs: the e-test of a finished profile run, repeated on cells drawn down to each cap, with an optional retrieval curve against reference gene sets. It is set and run in the Power module.
records.translation: Hur många celler per gen en optisk poolad screen behöver: e-testet för en avslutad profilkörning, upprepat på celler som dragits ned till varje tak, med en valfri återfinningskurva mot referensgenuppsättningar. Det ställs in och körs i Power-modulen.
